quizName:
Hardest Questions in Indiana
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left.

questions.question: You had a bad experience at work and feel angry. When you get to your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you won't think about it.
Drive fast on the interstate to let off steam.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving home.
Stop at a bar and have a few drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving home.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, wait before driving. Do not let your emotions affect your driving. Driving while upset puts you and others at risk.

questions.question: When you approach railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate comes down.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Not worry about how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At railroad tracks, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be prepared to stop if needed.

questions.question: When a school bus stops with its stop arm extended, you should:

options.text: Come to a complete stop and wait before moving forward.
Honk your horn before passing on the left.
Continue driving when you think most children have exited.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and wait before moving forward.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop when a school bus displays its stop signal. Do not move until the stop arm is withdrawn.

questions.question: Before taking a non-prescription drug and driving, you should:

options.text: Read the label on the drug.

questions.correctAnswerText: Read the label on the drug.
questions.explanation: Many over-the-counter drugs can affect your driving. Check the label for warnings about side effects. If unsure, ask your doctor or pharmacist.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: Which of these is a common cause of traffic accidents?

options.text: Driving too fast for the conditions

questions.explanation: Speeding causes many crashes. Not paying attention leads to collisions. Following too closely causes rear-end crashes.

questions.question: When driving on major highways, you should:

options.text: Be ready to react to hazards.

questions.explanation: Stay focused on the road. Move your eyes often to avoid highway hypnosis. Be prepared to react quickly to unexpected dangers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means large trucks are not permitted on this road.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if you do not see other traffic.
Signal only if other traffic is visible.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only in heavy night traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if you do not see other traffic.
questions.explanation: Always signal when turning, changing lanes, or pulling away from a curb. Do not skip this step or form bad habits.

questions.question: When encountering an aggressive driver, you should:

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make them know you disapprove of their driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and create distance between your car and theirs. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or use gestures.

questions.question: If you miss your freeway exit, you should:

options.text: Make a U-turn through the median.
Pull onto the shoulder and back up to the exit.
Flag down a police officer for help.

questions.explanation: Take the next exit. Do not stop, back up, swerve across lanes, or cross the median. These actions are illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns of farm machinery in the area.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, your eyes off the road, or your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must stop and give the right-of-way at the intersection. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: If someone is driving aggressively behind you, you should:

options.text: Try to get out of their way.
Stare at the driver as they pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Try to get out of their way.
questions.explanation: Get out of an aggressive driver's way. Avoid eye contact. Speeding up may make them angrier and more dangerous.

questions.question: Night driving is harder than day driving because:

options.text: You cannot see as far in the dark.
You see more motorcycles at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see as far in the dark.
questions.explanation: At night, you can see less. Use your headlights and drive slowly enough to stop within your field of vision.

questions.question: Texting while driving is:

options.text: Legal only for non-probationary license holders.

questions.explanation: In Indiana, you cannot type or read texts or emails while driving. The only exception is calling emergency services.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns of bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you to watch for danger and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When you leave your vehicle unattended, you must:

options.text: Lock the ignition and remove the key.

questions.explanation: When leaving your vehicle, you must turn off the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key, and set the parking brake.

questions.question: Driving ability can be harmed by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires being in good physical condition. Alcohol, medications, and tiredness can all harm your ability to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a playground is nearby. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: To avoid getting tired on a long drive, you should:

options.text: Stop and rest every two hours.
Drive with one eye open at a time.
Change feet on the gas pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest every two hours.
questions.explanation: Take a break every two hours on long trips. If you feel drowsy, pull over to a safe spot and rest or sleep. Do not keep driving if you are tired.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol hurts your vision, thinking, focus, and coordination.

questions.question: If you miss your exit on an interstate expressway, you should:

options.text: Get off at the next exit and go back to the exit you missed.
Roll down your window and ask the driver next to you for help.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get off at the next exit and go back to the exit you missed.
questions.explanation: Do not back up or turn around on the highway. Go to the next exit and safely turn around.

questions.question: You must stop your vehicle when:

options.text: A traffic officer tells you to stop.

questions.explanation: You must stop at stop signs, at red lights, and whenever a traffic officer orders you to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers the rules they must follow. This sign tells you to wait for the left turn signal before turning left.

questions.question: Drivers who eat or drink while driving:

options.text: Are better drivers because they are not hungry.

questions.explanation: Eating, drinking, or smoking while driving is dangerous. These actions take your hands off the wheel and your eyes off the road. Drivers who do these things have trouble staying in their lane and controlling their vehicle.

questions.question: A pedestrian starts to cross in front of your vehicle. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of the pedestrian.
Stop and let the pedestrian cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrian cross.
questions.explanation: Slow down and be ready to stop whenever you see pedestrians on or crossing the road. Be extra careful where children are present. Always let pedestrians cross first, especially in marked crosswalks.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, you must show:
questions.explanation: When stopped, you must show your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance. You must have all three documents in your vehicle when driving.

questions.question: When is it important to slow down?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, at intersections, at railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp or blind curves, where there are pedestrians or hazards, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: Before starting the engine, you should:

options.text: Make sure only backseat passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Make sure only adult passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Make sure only child passengers have buckled their seat belts.
Make sure all passengers have buckled their seat belts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure all passengers have buckled their seat belts.
questions.explanation: Create a routine for getting in and out of your car. Before starting the engine, fasten your seat belt and make sure all passengers do the same.

questions.question: You are approaching a railroad crossing and do not see or hear a train. You must stop if:
questions.explanation: Always stop before crossing railroad tracks if red lights are flashing, a gate is lowered, a stop sign is posted, a flagger signals you to stop, or a train is visible or close enough to be a hazard. Never race a train.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar vehicle from a friend. What should you do?

options.text: Not worry about it because all vehicles are the same.
Hide from your friend that you are unfamiliar with the vehicle.
Ignore any obvious defects to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take a few minutes to learn where the controls are and how to use them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to learn where the controls are and how to use them.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar vehicle, take time to find and learn how to use the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, gear shift, and horn. Fix any defects before driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Work zones are dangerous for drivers and construction workers. Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells drivers that penalties are increased for unsafe driving in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers the rules they must follow. This sign shows the slowest speed you can legally drive. Do not drive slower than this speed.

questions.question: Before turning, what should you do?
questions.explanation: To turn safely, turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn.

questions.question: Distracted driving can be caused by:

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.
Changing the radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers make about 200 decisions for every mile driven. You must focus completely on driving. Doing other tasks can be dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns drivers that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: If a crossing guard is directing traffic in a school zone, you must:

options.text: Follow the directions given by the crossing guard.
Copy what surrounding traffic is doing, despite the crossing guard's instructions.
Assume the guard is not supposed to be directing traffic.
Follow rules that would be in place if no children were present.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the directions given by the crossing guard.
questions.explanation: Always follow directions from a crossing guard, sign, or police officer. Slow down and use extra caution in school zones.

questions.question: If a flagger is directing traffic in a construction zone, you must:

options.text: Follow the directions given by the flagger.
Copy what surrounding traffic is doing, despite the flagger's instructions.
Assume the flagger is not supposed to be directing traffic.
Follow the laws that would be in place if the area was not under construction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the directions given by the flagger.
questions.explanation: Always follow directions from a flagger, sign, or police officer. Slow down and use extra caution in construction zones. Ignoring a flagger is illegal and dangerous to workers.

questions.question: If you are involved in a serious motor vehicle crash, you should:
questions.explanation: Stop your vehicle right away. Move it off the road if possible. Check if anyone is hurt. Call 911 if there are injuries. You must report the crash to police if someone is injured, someone dies, or damage exceeds $1,000 (or $200 to government property like signs or guardrails).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign is posted near intersections to remind drivers not to block the intersection.

questions.question: On a freeway, you realize you missed your turn or exit. What should you do?

options.text: Make the turn quickly from your lane of travel.
Continue driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or other location where you can safely turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or other location where you can safely turn around.
questions.explanation: Do not back up on a freeway or shoulder. Instead, continue to the next exit or safe place to turn around. Backing up on a freeway is illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in work zones. This sign tells drivers to follow an alternate route because the normal road is closed.

questions.question: In which of the following ways can alcohol affect you?

options.text: It gives you a feeling of false confidence.

questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time, reduces coordination, and harms your balance. It also weakens your vision and ability to judge distance. All of these effects make driving dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in work zones. This sign tells drivers that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive with extra caution.

questions.question: You are involved in an accident. What should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop your vehicle right away. Move it out of traffic if you can. Call the nearest police and ask for an ambulance if needed. Do not move injured people unless necessary. Apply direct pressure to stop severe bleeding. Wait for emergency vehicles to arrive.
